FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Consolidation Preceding MA20 Rebound as Fed Hawkishness Overrides Risk-Off
tldr_points: USD/JPY consolidates near 157.80, testing key support ahead of MA20 resistance at 157.92.
Risk-off sentiment from Nasdaq tech sell-off and crypto fears is countered by persistent Fed hawkishness on rates.
RSI at 46.5 indicates neutral momentum, setting up a tactical long entry on a dip.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY holds critical support at 157.80; tactical long bias favored toward MA20 at 157.92 as rate differential dominates.
FX.comment: USD/JPY consolidates near key support at 157.80; tactical long bias favored toward MA20 at 157.92 as rate differential dominates.

STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] UP: Oversold RSI Signals Tactical Bounce as Fed Put Re-Emerges
tldr_points: S&P 500 is trading significantly below its 20-day moving average at 7729.90, signaling a potential tactical oversold bounce.
RSI(14) has cooled to 34.08, indicating bearish momentum is exhausted in the short term.
Macro catalysts suggest the 'Fed put' remains active, providing a downside hedge for equity longs.
STOCKS.excerpt: Oversold RSI at 34.08 and drop below MA20 signal a tactical S&P 500 bounce as the Fed put anchors sentiment.
STOCKS.comment: Oversold RSI at 34.08 and proximity to key support suggest a tactical long setup targeting the 20-day MA.

CRYPTO.title: [BTC/USD] DOWN: Price Sub-MA20 Amid Security Crisis and Oversold Momentum Risk
tldr_points: BTC trades 4.4% below MA20 at $77,409 with RSI at 34.1 signaling momentum decay
Cascade of exchange hacks and regulatory scrutiny undermines custody confidence
Key support at $75,000 psychological level; break targets $72,000 structural gap
CRYPTO.excerpt: BTC breaks MA20 support as exchange security crises accelerate; downside bias toward $75k with oversold bounce risk.
CRYPTO.comment: Price sub-MA20 with negative funding and escalating custody crisis favors downside continuation to $75k
